sourceBook: Complete Key for Schools 2nd Student's Book
title: New penfriend
promptEn: Read Alex's email and write your own answer. Alex asks: Have you got any brothers and sisters? What things do you like doing? What kind of music do you like?
promptCn: 阅读 Alex 的邮件并回复。你需要回答：有没有兄弟姐妹、喜欢做什么、喜欢什么音乐。
requirements: Say if you have any brothers or sisters.
Say what things you like doing.
Say what kind of music you like.
sampleAnswer:
Hello Alex,
My name is Juan. I've got three brothers and one sister. I love spending time with my friends and I enjoy sports. I like all kinds of music, but Taylor Swift is my favourite!
Juan
writingFrame: I like ___ music, but ___ is my favourite!

aiDraftFields.label: 你有没有兄弟姐妹？
aiDraftFields.placeholder: one sister / no brothers or sisters

sourceBook: Complete Key for Schools 2nd Student's Book
title: A birthday story
promptEn: Look at the three pictures and write the story.
promptCn: 看三幅图，写一个小故事。图片之后你可以手动补上。
requirements: Give the boy a name.
Write something about each picture.
Write 35 words or more.
sampleAnswer: Mark got up and looked outside. He was happy because it was a sunny day. He decided to play football. He then found his football and hurried outside. Next, he called his friends. Later, his friends arrived, and they played together. They had a wonderful time!

aiDraftFields.label: 第三张图/结尾怎么样？
aiDraftFields.placeholder: His friends had a party for him

picturePrompts: Picture 1: What do you want to call the boy? Where is he?
Picture 2: Where is the boy? What is he doing?
Picture 3: Who can you see? How does the boy feel? What are they doing?

sourceBook: Complete Key for Schools 2nd Student's Book
title: Noah in the park
promptEn: Look at the three pictures. The story starts: Noah is in the park. He's feeling hot and wants to go in the pool. Finish the story.
promptCn: 看三幅图完成故事。开头是：Noah 在公园里，觉得很热，想进池塘/水池。
requirements: Use correct punctuation and capital letters.
Write what happens while Noah is swimming.
Write what happens when Noah gets out and how his mother feels.
writingFrame: Noah was in the park. He was feeling hot.
picturePrompts: Picture 1: Where is Noah? How does he feel?
Picture 2: What happens while Noah is swimming?
Picture 3: What does Noah do when he gets out? How does his mother feel?

sourceBook: Complete Key for Schools 2nd Student's Book
title: Go horse riding
promptEn: You want to go horse riding on Sunday with your English friend, Sam. Write an email to Sam.
promptCn: 你想周日和英文朋友 Sam 去骑马。给 Sam 写一封邮件。
requirements: Ask Sam to go horse riding with you.
Say where you want to go.
Tell Sam what to bring.
sampleAnswer:
Hi Julie,
Do you want to go surfing? I've got two surfboards, but you should bring a packed lunch. Let's meet at my house.
See you soon.
writingFrame: Do you want to go horse riding with me on Sunday?

sourceBook: Complete Key for Schools 2nd Student's Book
title: An interesting place
promptEn: You went to an interesting place in town yesterday. Write an email to your English friend, Jo.
promptCn: 你昨天去了城里一个有趣的地方。给英文朋友 Jo 写一封邮件。
requirements: Tell Jo where you went.
Say who you went with.
Say why you liked or didn't like it.
sampleAnswer:
Hi Sandra,
Yesterday I went to the car museum in town. My friend Julie was with me. I didn't like it because I think cars are boring!
Jenny
writingFrame: Yesterday I went to ___ in town.
I liked / didn't like it because ___.

aiDraftFields.label: 你喜欢吗？为什么？
aiDraftFields.placeholder: I liked it because it was fun

sourceBook: Complete Key for Schools 2nd Student's Book
title: The closed cinema
promptEn: Look at the pictures and write the story. Use the past simple.
promptCn: 看图写故事。注意使用一般过去时。
requirements: Write about each picture.
Use past simple verbs.
Write 35 words or more.
picturePrompts: Picture 1: What can you see? Where is the person going?
Picture 2: What happens at the cinema?
Picture 3: What does the person do in the end?

sourceBook: Complete Key for Schools 2nd Student's Book
title: Run in the park
promptEn: Gina says she would love to come for a run in the park with you. Answer her questions: What time shall we meet at your house? How are we going to get to the park? What will we do if it rains?
promptCn: Gina 想和你去公园跑步。回复她三个问题：几点在你家见？怎么去公园？如果下雨怎么办？
requirements: Say what time to meet.
Say how you will get to the park.
Say what you will do if it rains.
sampleAnswer:
Hello Gina,
I'm glad you can come. We'll meet at 1.30 at my house. We can walk to the park because it's not far. We'll stay inside and play games if it rains.
Best wishes,
Tony
writingFrame: We'll meet at ___ at my house.
We can ___ to the park because ___.

sourceBook: Complete Key for Schools 2nd Student's Book
title: A birthday surprise
promptEn: Look at the three pictures and write a story. Give the characters names and write something about each picture.
promptCn: 看三幅图写故事。给人物起名字，并写出每幅图发生的事。
requirements: Give the characters names.
Write something about each picture.
Use past tense to tell the story.
writingFrame: One morning, ___ was in the kitchen.
Then, ___ waited at the bus stop.
picturePrompts: Picture 1: Who is in the kitchen? What are they doing?
Picture 2: Who is waiting? Where are they?
Picture 3: Who can you see? What kind of party is it?

sourceBook: Complete Key for Schools 2nd Student's Book
title: Go sailing with Bobbie
promptEn: You want to go sailing on Saturday with your English friend, Bobbie. Write an email to Bobbie.
promptCn: 你想周六和英文朋友 Bobbie 去帆船运动。给 Bobbie 写一封邮件。
requirements: Ask Bobbie to go sailing with you on Saturday.
Say where you want to go sailing.
Tell Bobbie what he should take.
sampleAnswer:
Hi Maddy,
Would you like to come shopping with me on Saturday? Let's meet at 10 o'clock outside the library. I hope we will have a very nice time.
See you,
Federico
writingFrame: Would you like to go sailing with me on Saturday?

sourceBook: Complete Key for Schools 2nd Student's Book
title: Borrow a bike
promptEn: You want to borrow a bike from your English friend, Mike. Write an email to Mike.
promptCn: 你想向英文朋友 Mike 借自行车。给 Mike 写一封邮件。
requirements: Ask Mike if you can borrow his bike.
Explain why you need it.
Say when you will give it back.
sampleAnswer:
Hi Mike,
Could I borrow your bike next weekend, please? My cousins are coming to visit, and we're planning a bike ride in the forest. I had a bike, but it broke last month. I'll give it back to you on Sunday evening, and of course I'll clean it for you.
See you soon,
Tom

sourceBook: Complete Key for Schools 2nd Student's Book
title: A sunny football day
promptEn: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.
promptCn: 看三幅图，写出图中的故事。
requirements: Write 35 words or more.
Use past simple verbs.
Use time expressions such as first, then and later.
sampleAnswer: Mark got up and looked outside. He was happy because it was a sunny day. He decided to play football. He then found his football and hurried outside. Next, he called his friends. Later, his friends arrived, and they played together. They had a wonderful time!
picturePrompts: Picture 1: What did Mark see outside?
Picture 2: What did Mark do next?
Picture 3: Who arrived? What did they do together?
